title: Set a custom battery charge limit on MacBook
summary: Use the `bclm` tool to limit how much your MacBook battery charges, which can help extend its lifespan. You can set a specific percentage, such as 80%.

aliases.text: как ограничить заряд батареи на маке

prerequisites: The `bclm` tool must be installed (e.g., via Homebrew).

steps.explain: Set the maximum battery charge percentage. Replace <PERCENTAGE> with the desired limit (e.g., 80).

verify.expect: Displays the currently set charge limit.

rollback.explain: To remove the limit and allow full charging, you may need to reset the limit to 100% or use the unpersist command if it was made persistent.

warnings: This changes system power management settings.
On Intel Macs, the actual charge level may be slightly lower than the set value.
